data.text:
⚠️ TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Channel-Port aux Basques RCMP is reporting icy road conditions and limited visibility due to snow. Increasing winds are also impacting travel conditions through the Wreckhouse. 

At least two large vehicles are currently off the road, and officers are on scene assisting with traffic.

While the TCH is passable, motorists should expect delays and are asked to drive with extreme caution and patience. Slow down and obey all instructions from first responders. A reminder that the Move Over Law requires that you slow down for emergency vehicles.

Please consider delaying all non-essential travel. If you must travel, please exercise caution and patience and drive according to road and weather conditions.

Remember — snow means slow!
